issues.description: The PR moves the existing executable frame/metadata address conversions out of their implementation module into the specification module.
issues.rationale: The base keeps `frame_to_meta` and `meta_to_frame` in `ostd/src/mm/frame/meta/mapping.rs`, where runtime callers use them. This was the latest PR head when the author recognized that both exec functions should be put back into `mm` and the reviewer explicitly agreed. The selected head instead locates both executable definitions in `ostd/specs/mm/frame/mapping.rs`. This matches `preserve-exec-code`: proof refactoring should not move an established executable API merely to simplify specifications. The next historical revision restores the functions to `mm`, and the final approved head keeps them there.
